g.id: Container diagram for Compute Cost & Risk Monitor (2026-10-15)
Dashboard [Container: Streamlit web app] Shows comparable groups, workload cost and the what-if grid.
Normalizer [Container: Python CLI] Converts prices to USD per GPU-hour, groups them and checks their quality.
Collector [Container: Python CLI] Fetches Azure's GPU list prices and saves every response.
Monitor database [Container: DuckDB file] Collected prices, schema v2.
Raw responses [Container: gzip files + JSON] Every API response, as received.
Monitor database [Container: DuckDB file] schema v2 built
Market brief [Container: Python CLI] Writes the brief and re-derives every figure; can ask Claude to draft the text.
Demo command [Container: Python CLI] Builds the demo database and starts the dashboard.
GPU buyer [Person] Sizes a GPU workload and its budget.
Azure Retail Prices API [External system] Microsoft's published list prices.
Anthropic Claude API [External system] Paid AI model, called by hand.
Asks for the brief's text [HTTPS, JSON]

path.id: Key: blue = a container in this system (cylinder = data store) Â· white = person or external system Â· arrow = who acts on whom, labelled with what it does and [technology]
